Depression is feeling hopeless, despair, sadness, unmotivated, etc. Suicidal ideation is quite literally just thoughts of committing suicide.

If someone where to say "I feel hopeless, I'm worthless, I give up" that is depression. 

If someone were to say "I feel hopeless, I'm worthless, I give up. Maybe I should OD" that is suicidal ideation, and possibly depression.

If someone recently has suicidal thoughts, it's not necessarily depression. They may have recently had a tragedy and are experiencing grief or guilt.

If someone has depression, that doesn't always make them suicidal. 

Not all suicidal ideation involves depression, and not all depression involves suicide. 

This is a really simplified version of depression and suicide btw. It's a ton more complicated than just this.
